easy.def: A set of events that repeat.

more.def: A series of events that happen again and again in the same order.
examples: The water cycle moves water from the sea to the sky and back.
The seasons form a cycle each year.
The washing machine finished its cycle.
I cycle to school every day.
She cycled to the library on her new bike.

easy.def: A shape like a can, with flat round ends.

more.def: A shape with straight sides and two flat, round ends of the same size, like a can or a tube.
examples: A soup can is shaped like a cylinder.
The teacher held up a cylinder and asked us to count its flat faces.
Each of the tall candles was a perfect cylinder.
